# The one-year series counts from Trinity and starts at one; the three-year
# counts from Pentecost, with Trinity itself standing as the first.
# Reformation Day is kept on the Sunday on or before 31 October, and is
# "observed" only when it has actually moved: then the cell is red over the
# green of the Sunday it displaces.  All Saints' is kept on the first Sunday
# in November, white whatever the season.

# third-last, second-last and last Sundays (All Saints' wins the third-last).
